info.name: Ajaib Coin Exchange Spot Trading API

description.content:
RESTful API for the Ajaib Coin Exchange (Ajaib Kripto), the crypto trading venue operated by Ajaib in Indonesia. The API is organized into three surfaces: Market Info (general exchange information), Wallet (portfolio balances) and Spot Trading (view, place and cancel orders and trades). All requests and responses use the `application/json` content type and request URLs are case-sensitive and must be lowercase.

Contact Support:
 Name: Ajaib Coin Exchange
 Email: tech@ajaib.co.id
